review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of the read/decode/publish/lookup chain over the installation (m01-radio-sample-census.json). Claim is implemented only, not checked: no independent reviewer has looked at this run, no original executable ran and no person heard anything. MEASURED (retail, read-only): the member VO_c2-NW-m1_WorkersVoyage_1.wav of ZBD/soundsh.zbd decodes to 104500 mono frames at 11025 Hz through the production VFS/`ZbdContainer`/`sound_member_pcm` chain, and its dialogue id is ContentKind::Dialogue over F14-D.7's install_file_key spelling; after `publish_voice_members` the device's own lookup finds it (only the absent output refuses, device_closed), while an id nothing published is refused sample_unavailable by name. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED: the identity rule and route (b) are the owner's designed decision (task #1465 note of 2026-10-15) because the installation states no cue class (F14-D.7), so nothing here is verified_original; which of ZBD/soundsh.zbd and ZBD/soundsl.zbd the original opens is unmeasured, so the container is the labelled choice #1438 made; the producer that calls `publish_voice_members` is #1438's prepare step and is still open (filed as #1466), so this report does not claim M01 is audible end to end. The 3 assertions discovered under this task's own prefix are the tests of this report. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
